package.name: isaac_ros2_messages
package.description:
Service definitions for Isaac Sim's ROS2ServicePrim node.
Isaac ships these compiled for Humble only (exts/isaacsim.ros2.bridge/humble/) and this container is Jazzy, so they are rebuilt here from the same interface. Field names and types were read out of Isaac's own generated bindings -- they must match exactly or the call finds no server and simply times out.
Name and version deliberately match NVIDIA's package: a client built from this talks to the real one.
